legacy_values: Autofluorescence Microscopy collected from the right kidney of a 64 year old White male donorby the Biomolecular Multimodal Imaging Center (BIOMC) at Vanderbilt University. BIOMIC is a Tissue Mapping Centerthat is part of the NIH funded Human Biomolecular Atlas Program (HuBMAP).
